'''Tamvar Senzen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was present in a hotel in the city of [[Kaadara]], on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tamvar Senzen was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Tamvar Senzen was located in the Kaadara hotel,<ref name="SWG" /> where he was intended to give four quests to players.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files and source data}}</ref> However, the character was completely bugged and did not propose any quest.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=game_guides&message.id=148427|text=Quests NPC all around SWG World - March 2004}}</ref> In the first quest, the player would have been tasked to escort a woman named [[Shandara]] in order to corrupt the [[Leb Slesher]]. In later quests, the player was intended to deliver a damaged [[Datacard/Legends|datadisk]] to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]], kill an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and then kill a thug.<ref name="TRE" />
